method.geometry: Actual GLB indexed triangles with hierarchical matrix/TRS transforms; collision/nonRender helpers excluded.
method.camera: Orthographic view normalize([0.38,0.65,0.66]); four independently fitted panels, not a shared scene or scale comparison.
method.materials: Base-color factors multiplied by centroid-sampled embedded PNG textures; approximate gamma 2.2; flat two-sided absolute-normal light plus emissive factor.
method.rendering: CPU triangle-depth painter sorting, 2x supersampling and Lanczos downsample; WebP quality 80 method 6.

reproduction.scope: Portable source reconstructs the original preview method against the hash-pinned restored parts GLBs. Syntax checked without executing or rerendering. Encoding and font rasterization can vary by dependency version; byte-identical reproduction is not claimed. Exact reviewed image is pinned separately.

review.observations: Readable panels show the paired-pylon spine, twin-cylinder power skid, elbow guide, and twin-box cargo rack. Guide remains plain/block-like in this flat preview.
limitations: Not live-game evidence or native camera acceptance.
Not PBR shading, texture-detail acceptance, or final visual-quality acceptance.
Painter sorting and centroid texture sampling are simplified and may omit or misorder fine details.
No invented geometry or gameplay placement.
